description: Read the Launchpad card: confirmed_signups, emailable_subscribers, awaiting_confirmation, confirmed this week and queued confirmations, confirmation allowance, list size versus plan emails, share URL, launch_url, main_page, offline (true while the owner has taken the launch page offline) and the launch page's saved settings (launch_page: launch note, first button, published, offline, design: the advanced editor blocks or null). The launch page is separate from Your page; main_page says which one hollerpost.com/@handle shows. custom_domain (when the feature is on): the launch page's own address, its status (waiting_dns, securing, live, error), the fix for an error and the CNAME record to add. Requires API key scope: read.
name: launchpad_get
title: Get Launchpad
